content: The Legion Go S with SteamOS is a pretty solid alternative to the $789 Steam Deck OLED. It runs identical software, but ships in a design with two-stage triggers, a bigger eight-inch IPS screen (1080p and up to 120Hz versus 800p and 90Hz in the Deck OLED), and it’s got double the RAM and storage (32GB and 1TB, respectively), not to mention a slightly faster processor in the Ryzen Z1 Extreme. At $999.99, its current discounted price at Best Buy, it’s worth considering if you’re deciding on a handheld. The Legion Go S is not as powerful as the $1,299.99 Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 that just launched, which has the Z2 Extreme and a OLED screen, but it’s no slouch, either. [Product: Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS (Z1 Extreme) | https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fsite%2Flegion-go-s-8-120hz-gaming-handheld-amd-ryzen-z1-extreme-steamos-32gb-with-1tb-ssd-steam%2F6619188.p] This model launched with Windows 11 and the Ryzen Z2 Go. Despite being a newer chip, it’s less powerful than the Z1 Extreme in the discounted model. SteamOS and the faster internals within this configuration will provide a better experience. Check out my colleague Sean Hollister’s review of multiple configs of the Go S, and see how it stacks up in his benchmarks.

chineseContent: 搭载 SteamOS 的 Legion Go S 是 789 美元 Steam Deck OLED 的相当可靠的替代品。它运行相同的软件，但采用两级触发器的设计，更大的 8 英寸 IPS 屏幕（1080p 和高达 120Hz，而 Deck OLED 中为 800p 和 90Hz），并且 RAM 和存储空间增加了一倍（分别为 32GB 和 1TB），更不用说 Ryzen Z1 Extreme 中稍快的处理器了。目前百思买的折扣价为 999.99 美元，如果您决定购买手持设备，那么值得考虑。 Legion Go S 的功能虽然不如刚推出的售价 1,299.99 美元的华硕 ROG Xbox Ally X20（后者配备 Z2 Extreme 和 OLED 屏幕）强大，但也毫不逊色。 [产品：搭载 SteamOS 的 Lenovo Legion Go S (Z1 Extreme) | https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fsite%2Flegion -go-s-8-120hz-gaming-handheld-amd-ryzen-z1-extreme-steamos-32gb-with-1tb-ssd-steam%2F6619188.p]该型号随 Windows 11 和 Ryzen Z2 Go 一起推出。尽管是较新的芯片，但它的功能不如折扣型号的 Z1 Extreme。 SteamOS 和此配置中更快的内部结构将提供更好的体验。查看我的同事 Sean Hollister 对 Go S 的多个配置的评论，看看它在他的基准测试中的表现如何。
